findings.highlight: "…That's the reason it took so much effort to make him look at me again. That's the reason it was so hard for him to overcome the past."
findings.evidenceJa:
「…そのせいでもう一度振り向かせるのに苦労したけどね。
昔のこと乗り越えるの、大変だったけどね」
findings.explanation: Setsuna describes her own difficulty in making Haruki turn back toward her and overcoming their past; the English assigns the second struggle solely to Haruki.
findings.japanese:
「…そのせいでもう一度振り向かせるのに苦労したけどね。
昔のこと乗り越えるの、大変だったけどね」
findings.todokanai: "…That's the reason it took so much effort to make him look at me again. That's the reason it was so hard for him to overcome the past."

findings.highlight: "Though, I wouldn't put it past him to cheat on you in secret."
findings.evidenceJa: 「まぁ、隠れて浮気くらいならアリかもしんないけど」
findings.explanation: Tomo says a secret affair might at least be possible or conceivable; 'I wouldn't put it past him' instead characterizes Haruki as the sort of man expected to cheat.
findings.japanese: 「まぁ、隠れて浮気くらいならアリかもしんないけど」
findings.todokanai: "Though, I wouldn't put it past him to cheat on you in secret."

findings.highlight: My friend from five years ago has returned
findings.evidenceJa: 親友が五年ぶりに帰国してきた
findings.explanation: Setsuna calls Kazusa her best friend, who has returned to Japan after five years. The translation instead calls her a friend from five years ago, weakening the relationship into a past association.
findings.japanese:
「親友が五年ぶりに帰国してきたっていうのに、
連絡も取ろうとしない。素直に喜べない。
そんな、嫌な女の子ですよ～だ」
findings.todokanai: "My friend from five years ago has returned, and I haven't even tried to contact her. I can't even feel happy about her return. I'm that kind of an unpleasant girl."

findings.highlight: end up giving Kazusa unpleasant memories
findings.evidenceJa: かずさにだって…もしかしたら嫌な思いさせてるかも
findings.explanation: Setsuna fears that her current avoidance and jealousy may also be causing Kazusa painful feelings. The translation turns the ongoing emotional harm into the creation of unpleasant memories.
findings.japanese:
「やだもう、自己嫌悪…
こんなことじゃ、余計に春希くんに愛想尽かされる。
かずさにだって…もしかしたら嫌な思いさせてるかも」
findings.todokanai: "Oh jeez, I'm self-loathing now… Haruki-kun will just get sick of me like this. I might even… end up giving Kazusa unpleasant memories."

findings.highlight: she's been kicked from the band
findings.evidenceJa: もめた末に結局飛び出しちゃって
findings.explanation: After conflict over dating both the drummer and bassist, the singer ultimately stormed out or left the band herself. The translation says the band expelled her.
findings.japanese:
「ところがその子がとんでもないタマで…
ドラムとベースを二股かけちゃって、
もめた末に結局飛び出しちゃってさぁ」
findings.todokanai: "But the girl was absolutely unbelievable… She two-timed both the drummer and the bassist, so she's been kicked from the band."
